result.generation_response: Richmond Police Department invoice dated April 30, 2021 (Invoice #04-30-2021-03) from Chief Gerald M. Smith responding to a MuckRock News FOIA request. The request seeks use of force incident data (2013-2019) including incidents separated by year and type, civilian complaints and sustained complaints, use of force complaints, biased policing complaints, and officer-involved shooting details. The invoice charges $80.00 for 2 hours of Timekeeper Major Crimes work and $20.00 for 30 minutes of Internal Affairs work, totaling $100.00. Payment should be sent to Richmond Police Department Central Records Unit, 200 West Grace Street, Richmond, VA 23220.

The Richmond Police Department accepts payment via Certified Check, Money Order, and Cash (mail cash not recommended). Contact: Chief Gerald M. Smith, 200 W. Grace Street, Richmond, VA 23220. Phone: 804.646.6700, Fax: 804.646.3974. Website: www.ci.richmond.va.us/police/
